parsed_json.up: Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy. Join: molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to include parent and salts; compound_records on molregno; docs on doc_id; activities on record_id; assays on assay_id; target_dictionary on tid; compound_structures on molregno. Filter: parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3338195'; target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL395'; standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, activity_comment ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
